other_conditions: Investment must be made on or after 1 April 2017.
The unit must provide at least 60% of its employment to residents of Puducherry, and maintain this ratio for the period specified in the affidavit.
Prior approval from the Director of Industries is required for participation in the exhibition.
The unit shall not transfer or dispose of fixed assets for five years from the date of application submission or subsidy disbursement, whichever is later.
Additional investments made after the first claim are eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.

If two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same person, they are eligible as separate entities provided they are in different locations and have separate licences/clearances/registrations.

Application deadline for new units: within one year from the date of commencement of obtaining the Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part‑2/ Permanent Registration/ Commencement of Production Certificate. Application deadline for existing units: within one year of completion of expansion/diversification/modernization.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 50% of rent, literature and display material (maximum ₹5,00,000) for participation in international trade fairs.
